items.title: 22.6.1 Phenols mein -OH group ke reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the reactions of the -OH group of phenol (PDF 95-96).

blocks.text: Phenol ka -OH group thora tezaabi hai, is liye phenol acid-base reactions mein hissa leta hai.

items: Bases ke saath: phenol bare non-polar ring ki wajah se paani mein thora ghulta hai, lekin alkaline mehloolon mein react kar ke ghulne wala namak aur paani deta hai: C6H5OH + NaOH -> C6H5O-Na+ + H2O (sodium phenoxide).

blocks.alt: Phenol (acid), OH wala benzene ring, + NaOH (base) se sodium phenoxide, O- Na+ wala ring, + H2O. Labels: phenol, sodium hydroxide, sodium phenoxide.
blocks.caption: i) Phenol aur sodium hydroxide (kitab ke PDF safha 95 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Reactive dhaaton ke saath: pighla phenol sodium se tezi se react karta hai, yeh bhi acid-base reaction, ghulne wala namak aur hydrogen bante hain: 2C6H5OH + 2Na -> 2C6H5O-Na+ + H2.

blocks.alt: 2 phenol + 2Na se 2 sodium phenoxide (O- Na+ wala ring) + H2. Labels: phenol, sodium, sodium phenoxide.
blocks.caption: ii) Phenol aur sodium (kitab ke PDF safha 95 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke mua'adle mein baen taraf sirf aik phenol aur 2Na chhapa hai, jabke daen taraf 2 sodium phenoxide hain, yani mua'adla balance nahi. Sahi: 2 phenol + 2Na -> 2 sodium phenoxide + H2, jaisa hamare khaake mein hai. Har phenol ka O-H toot'ta hai aur do H mil kar aik H2 molecule banate hain.

items: Acyl chlorides ke saath: base ki maujoodgi mein acyl chloride ke saath garam kiya phenol ester deta hai. Base phenol se proton hata kar phenoxide ion banata, jo behtar nucleophile hai aur carbonyl carbon par hamla karta: CH3COCl + C6H5OH -> CH3COOC6H5 (phenyl ethanoate) + HCl.

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wala ethanoyl chloride, CH3-C(=O)-Cl, + phenol, HO-C6H5, teer ke oopar NaOH aur neeche Heat, se phenyl ethanoate, CH3-C(=O)-O-C6H5, + HCl.
blocks.caption: iii) Ethanoyl chloride aur phenol se phenyl ethanoate (kitab ke PDF safha 96 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Ester, ether nahi
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke phenol aur acyl chloride ke reaction se ether banta hai. Product, phenyl ethanoate (CH3COOC6H5), ester hai, jaisa kitab ka apna mua'adla dikhata hai.

blocks.alt: Hydroxide ion apne lone pair se (mura teer) phenol ke O-H ka H leta hai, aur doosra mura teer O-H bond ke electrons ko O par le jata hai. Natija phenoxide ion, 'better nucleophile than the phenol', + H2O.
blocks.caption: Phenol aur hydroxide ion se phenoxide ion (kitab ke PDF safha 96 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: OH- ka lone pair phenol ke H ko kheenchta hai (pehla mura teer) aur O-H bond ke electrons O par chale jate hain (doosra mura teer). Bachne wala phenoxide ion manfi hai, is liye phenol se behtar nucleophile hai aur ethanoyl chloride ke carbonyl carbon par hamla karta hai. Kitab ke khaake mein banne wala paani (H2O) nahi likha; hamare khaake mein '+ H2O' shamil hai.

items: Diazonium ions ke saath: yeh reaction Chapter 24 (Organic Nitrogen Compounds) mein bayan hai.

blocks.prompt: Phenol sodium hydroxide ke mehlool mein kyun ghulta hai lekin paani mein thora?
blocks.explanation: Paani mein bara non-polar ring hall pazeeri mehdood karta hai; NaOH tezaabi -OH se react kar ke ionic, ghulne wala namak sodium phenoxide banata hai.

items: Phenol + NaOH -> sodium phenoxide + paani; + Na -> sodium phenoxide + H2.
Phenol + acyl chloride (base ke saath) -> ester (phenyl ethanoate).
